t: The Viva Rigid 90° Angled WC Pan Connector connects a toilet pan to the soil pipe with a secure and leak-free seal. This reliable fitting is ideal for professional plumbers and bathroom installers working on domestic renovations or commercial refits. Manufactured from durable white plastic, this 230mm connector features simple push-fit connections for straightforward installation. Installers can easily cut the rigid length to size, ensuring a perfect match for standard 4" PVC-U and cast-iron pipework.
